#
# The Python packages release.yml's build-core job installs, locked with hashes
# (security review 2026-11-22). build-core is the job that cuts the five
# shipping images. Installed with
#   pip install --force-reinstall --require-hashes --no-deps
#     --only-binary :all: -r <this file>
# so every package, transitive ones included, must be listed here with its
# exact version and the hash of the one wheel pip may use. --force-reinstall
# matters: a package that is already installed at a pinned version is
# otherwise "already satisfied" and skips the hash check.
#
# Target: CPython 3.12 on x86_64 glibc Linux (setup-python "3.12" on
# ubuntu-24.04). Each hash is for one wheel, so a different Python or platform
# needs that wheel's hash added, not a looser pin.
#
# What is in it: west (1.5.0, the version the NCS v3.4.0 toolchain bundle
# ships) plus the closure of Zephyr ncs-v3.4.0's scripts/requirements-base.txt,
# which upstream calls "required to build or create images with zephyr".
# windows-curses is win32-only and is left out. docopt is left out too: it is
# a dependency of pykwalify, but only pykwalify's command-line entry point
# imports it, and docopt 0.6.2 is published as an sdist only, so
# --only-binary :all: cannot install it. `pip check` will report it missing.
# That is expected: the build imports pykwalify.core, which does not need it.
# This replaces action-zephyr-setup's unhashed, open-range install of
# zephyr/scripts/requirements.txt, which also pulled in the test, run and
# compliance extras. A shipping build does not import those.
#
# Regenerated 2026-11-23 in an ubuntu:24.04 container (Python 3.12.3):
#   python3 -m venv v && v/bin/pip install west==1.5.0 \
#     -r <zephyr>/scripts/requirements-base.txt   (minus windows-curses)
#   v/bin/pip freeze --all, minus pip and docopt  -> the pins below
#   pip download --no-deps --only-binary=:all: --platform manylinux2014_x86_64
#     --platform manylinux_2_17_x86_64 --platform manylinux_2_28_x86_64
#     --python-version 3.12 --implementation cp --abi cp312 --abi abi3
#     --abi none <pin>   (for each pin)
# then sha256 of each wheel, cross-checked against the digest PyPI's JSON API
# publishes for that file (all 40 agreed). The locked install was then run in a
# fresh venv with the flags above, followed by west init/update and a west
# build of a shipping row.
